notes.title: ✨ The Wonders of Wizardry ✨
notes.content: [h2]👋🏻 Greetings Spellcasters![/h2][p][/p][p]Today we are doing something we hope to do a lot of going forward. We are partaking in a Steam event for the first time; the [i]Wonders Of Wizardry Steam[/i] event ([url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45284712/sale/WondersofWizardry2025"]make sure to check out the event page and see the other games that are in it[/url])! To make it extra special we have a [b]freshly cooked update[/b] for it.[/p][p][/p][p]We call today's update The Wonders Of Wizardry Update. This is what's new in it...[/p][list][*][p]New cards with a [i]handy [/i]effect, and others yet that might [i]conjure[/i] up your imagination.[/p][/*][*][p]New encounters with monsters that don't mess around.[/p][/*][*][p]Spells now have visual effects, for a more satisfying casting experience![/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed art to make everything more cohesive.[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life features requested by our playtesters.[/p][/*][*][p]A reporting feature to make it easier to submit feedback, requests and bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you would like a more comprehensive list, Daan wrote up a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3889580/view/505088397281329257"]full change log over here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681886/fbbcfd7b31fd55bac122e666599aeefb470bfd91.png"][/img][/p][h2]💬 We need your feedback![/h2][p]The biggest pitfall for new deckbuilders seems to be the lack of balance and replayability. That's why we're partaking in this event as a publicly accessible [i]Alpha[/i] instead of as a [i]Demo[/i], [b]we want to take these things seriously from the beginning[/b].[/p][p]Since the game is still in its early stages, there are many features still in development as well as content to be made. Daan and I work hard every day to get it all in there! [/p][p]With your help we'll be able to get Bibidi Bibidi to where it needs to be a lot quicker.[/p][p]So please share your thoughts with us after playing! Either in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/zEkp5gjUP2"]Bibidi Bibidi discord server[/url] or by using the bug report button in-game.[/p][p][/p][p]And one last favour: if you know anyone who's into deckbuilders, would you tell them about the game? I mean it when I say we need playtesters and feedback![/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now![/p][p][/p][p]Magical regards ❤️,[/p][p]- Jonas & Daan[/p]

notes.title: 📍 The 2025 Roadmap for Bibidi Bibidi!
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Hello fellow Wizards, Witches and Spellcasters! ✨[/h2][p]We're pleased to announce an update to our public alpha playtest! We've added this little guy as a shopkeeper in-between combat encounters. Adorable little menace, isn't he? If you don't watch out, he'll rip you off though, so stay vigilant.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681886/7b9ee5e5460960bf575212d236ecb8555993fbf8.jpg"][/img]With that and various other changes, we've reached a pretty solid milestone on our roadmap. Our core gameplay features are in, we've got silly voices for the wizard, a solid set of basic cards and combat encounters. But what else is on planning, you ask? Let's take a look shall we?[/p][p][/p][h1]The Road Map[/h1][p]We've planned out various updates for the coming months. Hopefully this will give you a decent idea of what the game has in store for the future.[/p][p][/p][h3]💫 Sigils Update[/h3][p]In the next update, we'll be introducing our take on Relics/Artifacts that we've come to know and love from deckbuilders. These will be passive upgrades you collect throughout your run to really tie your build together. We'll also add more cards, effects and hopefully encounters to make the game more varied and fun.[/p][h3]🚪 Doors Update[/h3][p]After that, we'll be taking a look at interesting ways to find your way through the dungeon. Select risky elite encounters for better rewards or play it safe by sticking to shops and easier combat. We might handle things a little differently than that you're used to, so keep an eye out. [/p][p][/p][h3]📋 Further down the line...[/h3][p]After that, we've got a whole slew of content planned.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="541,"][tr][th colwidth="541"][p]Content/Feature[/p][/th][th][p]Status[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]New spell cards, schools and effects.[/p][/td][td][p][i][b]🔨 Upcoming...[/b][/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]More varied monsters and combat encounters.[/p][/td][td][p][i][b]🔨 Upcoming...[/b][/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Managing and previewing your deck.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Permanent progression systems[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Events, narrative and non-combat encounters.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]New potions and consumables.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Spellbooks and classes![/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Difficulty scaling and ascension system.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]New and alternative bosses.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Steam achievements.[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="541"][p]Music and better sound effects (we will squeeze that in somewhere)[/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]To clarify, this is a rough idea of which order we will do things. It might change a bit on the fly depending on what happens and on your feedback.[/p][p][i]As the artist (hey it's Jonas), I'd also like to mention that this is not the final look of the game. All the art in the game is basically sketches. I will polish it all up when we feel confident about the designs of the backgrounds and characters.[/i][/p][h2]One last thing![/h2][p]Now is a great time to jump in! Since we want this game to have a lot of replay value, we need your feedback to get there. So please come share your feedback with us in [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FzEkp5gjUP2"]the official Bibidi Bibidi discord[/url]![/p][p]Or just come to hang out and talk wizardry with us. OK, that's all for now! [/p][p][/p][p]Bibidi Bye![/p][p]- Jonas & Daan[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681886/266c1db9fc02b0cf2e1598567572b1c1582d703a.png"][/img][/p]
